description: Standard compliance requirements under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.

requirements.title: Common or Generic Name of Commodity
requirements.description: Every package must bear the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure commodity generic name is clearly printed in prominent lettering on Principal Display Panel.

requirements.title: Net Quantity in Standard Units of Measurement
requirements.description: Net quantity must be declared in standard SI metric units (g, kg, ml, L, m, or count/N) without non-standard abbreviations.
requirements.recommendation_template: Verify net quantity declaration with standard SI units (g, kg, ml, L, N) and correct font size.

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP - Inclusive of all taxes)
requirements.description: Retail sale price must be declared as 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs./₹ ... incl. of all taxes'.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print MRP clearly in Indian Rupees with explicit 'inclusive of all taxes' mention.

requirements.title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
requirements.description: Month and year in which commodity is manufactured or pre-packed must be clearly indicated.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure legible month and year of packaging (MM/YYYY) is embossed or printed.

requirements.title: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer
requirements.description: Complete name and address of manufacturer, packer, or importer must be printed.
requirements.recommendation_template: Provide full corporate address including city, state, and postal PIN code.

requirements.title: Consumer Care Details (Phone, Email, Address)
requirements.description: Name, address, telephone number, and email ID of person/office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
requirements.recommendation_template: Provide complete consumer care helpline number, official grievance email, and postal address.

requirements.title: Country of Origin Declaration
requirements.description: Country of origin must be stated prominently on all imported and domestic pre-packaged products.
requirements.recommendation_template: Specify 'Country of Origin: [Country]' prominently on label.
